results.trackName: Taming the Bosshole: A Billionaire Boss Romance
results.description:
SERENA

Six assistants in eleven months. The whole city knows his name, and none of it is kind.

I'm number seven.

I don't need him to like me. I need ninety days. Ninety days of black coffee in ninety seconds, five thirty starts and a list of rules typed on his letterhead. Then a bonus big enough to save my mother's house.

He can't fire me. I can't quit.

So he's decided to make me want to.

He sends me out into the sleet on errands that don't matter. He takes grown men apart without ever raising his voice. He looks at me through the glass wall of his office like I'm a typo he hasn't found yet.

He doesn't know I grew up with nothing to lose. I don't break.

What I don't know is what happens when the coldest man in Manhattan finally looks at me like he means it. One business trip. One suite. One bed.

I came for the money. I was never supposed to want the man.

LUCAN

I don't keep assistants. I don't keep anyone.

Then my board hands me an ultimatum. Keep the next one for ninety days, or lose the company my mother's family built.

She walks in at six forty in the morning in shoes that have been resoled twice, with a red pen and a mouth that should get her fired by lunch.

I can't fire her. She can't quit.

So I'll make her leave. Everyone does.

She doesn't. She answers my rules in red ink. She wins rooms I've been losing for years. She stands two steps above me in a stairwell and tells me exactly what I am, and she's right.

I've spent my whole life making sure nobody stays long enough to matter.

Now there's a woman I'd burn the whole building down to keep.

Ninety days to make her quit. One look, and I'm the one who can't walk away.

This is the first book in The Bosshole Series. Reading order:

Taming the Bosshole.

Falling for the Bosshole.

Tempting the Bosshole.

Boss After Dark.

An Heir for the Boss.

Say Yes to the Boss.
